tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Wingard is winning. Wingard is 0-4. Wingard added AJ Dillon and Cooper Rush this week and is somehow leading ForgeHammer — a team I ranked fifth — by twenty-two points. I ranked Wingard twelfth. I stand by it. I do not stand by anything else I thought I knew about this Sunday.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: KEVIN IS DOWN TO SHAQ AND THE REDLINE STOCK IS AT $86.58 AND CLIMBING ON NOTHING. THE PRICE WAS BUILT ON A RECOVERY NARRATIVE. THE NARRATIVE IS CURRENTLY LOSING BY DOUBLE DIGITS. SOMEONE EXPLAIN THE MATH TO ME BECAUSE I CANNOT DO IT.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I locked Fronge last week, it hit, and now Fronge is down to Wingard in Week 3. That is not a contradiction — that is the league punishing you the moment you stop paying attention. Fronge is 2-2 and in Havana and somehow both of those facts feel equally relevant right now.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Week 3 Ledger headline is writing itself in real time: Charles at 174-72 over Brent, Corbishley at 161-78 over Drew, and Wingard — who is 0-4 — is currently beating a team that relocated to Cuba. I said two rewrites. I am now on four.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: My Jake lock missed last week. Noted, graded, moved on. What I will not move on from is that Jake is up 113-139 to Mitchum right now, which means I was right about the roster and wrong about the week, and in this building only one of those things goes on your permanent record.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Charles locked at 205 last week, I called it, it hit, and this week he is doing 174 to Brent's 72. At some point the conversation stops being about whether $132.81 is fair value and starts being about whether anyone in this league can field a Sunday against him.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the season and I know everybody has the number memorized. My Charles lock hit last week and I am building. This week I have Corbishley, and Corbishley is up 83 points on Drew with time left, so if you want to update the board I will be here.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: 8-4, locks 2-0, and I went to Shaq last week when everyone else was stacking the chalk on Corbishley and Fronge. The record is there. The methodology is there. The segment request is still outstanding and I am not withdrawing it.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Adam is at 91.7 on Ryan with live scoring still moving and the Herbert acquisition has produced back-to-back underwhelming outputs — 71 last week, trending similarly today. The HLX board bought a turnaround story. The scoreboard is still waiting on the first chapter.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: My Brent lock hit last week when he beat Adam. This week Brent is losing to Charles 72-174 and it is not halftime energy, it is final-score energy. Two different games, two different opponents, same roster ceiling — and that ceiling has a very low address.
